title: Hybrid Identity Configuration
scenario: You are preparing an on-premises Active Directory environment for hybrid identity with Microsoft Entra ID. Complete the activities below to demonstrate the correct process for domain preparation, identity cleanup, Entra Connect configuration, and synchronization validation.

activities.prompt: Arrange the following steps in the correct order to add and validate a custom domain for hybrid identity.
steps: Create the TXT record in public DNS
answer: Create the TXT record in public DNS

activities.prompt: Select the tool used to identify directory attribute issues before synchronization.
activities.explanation: IdFix is used to identify and remediate attribute issues before hybrid sync.

activities.prompt: Complete the user principal name format that should match the cloud domain before synchronization.
Match each hybrid identity task to its purpose.
left: Configure Entra Connect with Password Hash Synchronization
right: Align user sign-in names with the cloud domain
Synchronize on-prem identities to Microsoft Entra ID
Confirm a synchronized account can authenticate
answers: Align user sign-in names with the cloud domain
Synchronize on-prem identities to Microsoft Entra ID
Confirm a synchronized account can authenticate

activities.prompt: Select the tasks that belong to the Entra Connect deployment stage.
Arrange the synchronization validation workflow in the correct order.
steps: Verify synchronized users appear in Microsoft Entra ID
Test sign-in with a synchronized account
answer: Verify synchronized users appear in Microsoft Entra ID
Test sign-in with a synchronized account
